title: Wave Lab
description: A real stretch of coast, solved wave by wave. Every crest on the wall is shallow-water physics running live — waves slow in shallow water, bend toward the shore, steepen and break, and drag the sand into bars and channels that then change where the next wave breaks. Set the weather from your phone, drop a reef or a pier in the water, and watch the beach rearrange itself around it.
action_hints: set the sea from glassy to storm, or send one rogue wave
touch the beach on your phone and the wall splashes where your finger went
swap the coastline for a coral reef and watch the lagoon go calm
put a pier in the water and see the sand scour out around the piles
turn on currents to find the rip running back out to sea
pile up sand, dig a channel through a bar, and see what the surf does to it
